question.problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}2x-4y-8z=4 \\ 3x-6y-12z=6 \\ -4x+8y+16z=-8\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & -8 & 4 \\ 3 & -6 & -12 & 6 \\ -4 & 8 & 16 & -8\end{aligned}].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & -8 & 4 \\ 3 & -6 & -12 & 6 \\ -4 & 8 & 16 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -4 & 2 \\ 3 & -6 & -12 & 6 \\ -4 & 8 & 16 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 8 & 16 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
